simulators.name: Heart Lab
simulators.description: Explore the human circulatory system: the four heart chambers, the one-way valves, and the flow of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood through the lungs and around the body.
topics: Heart valves and one-way blood flow
learningObjectives: Describe the route of a red blood cell through both circuits
Identify the four chambers and the valves between them
Explain why the left ventricle has the thickest walls
Explain how valves prevent blood flowing backwards

related.note: Compare how two different systems move energy — blood through the body, current through a transformer

simulators.name: Transformer Lab
simulators.description: Take apart a distribution transformer: the core, windings, bushings, radiators, cooling fans, oil conservator, tap changer and more.
learningObjectives: Explain how a transformer changes AC voltage
State the turns ratio and use it to predict output voltage
Describe why the core is laminated
Identify the parts that keep a transformer cool
Explain why transformers work with AC and not DC

related.note: Both simulators show how energy is moved through a system — compare the two layouts
